selector.rationale: Atrophic gastritis best explains the histologic findings of foveolar hyperplasia, shortened parietal cell layer, and mild lymphocytic infiltration, with heterogeneous reduction of H+/K+-ATPase staining and uneven pepsinogen I staining.

rejected.label: Chronic gastritis
rejected.why: Lack of strong evidence and lower score compared to atrophic and autoimmune gastritis

rejected.label: Autoimmune gastritis
rejected.why: Presence of a strong contradiction (AX_SE004) and lower score compared to atrophic gastritis
